waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: race-1-gone-lock-abandoned
mutations.why: The code before the fix: touched() gave 0 for a lock that was gone, so judge called it abandoned, and takeOver then asked existsSync, saw another waiter's fresh mkdir and removed it.
mutations.search:
ELSE seenTouched[p] /\ seenDead[p] /\ confirmed[p]

\* What takeOver checks for "no lock": the code before the fix asked existsSync now, the fix uses judge's own stat.
TakeoverSeesNoLock(p) == IF GoneIsAbandoned THEN ~lockExists ELSE ~seenTouched[p]

mutations.name: race-2-first-read-trusted
mutations.why: The other half of the old code: a pid found dead condemned whatever lock was there by then, though its owner had released and a new waiter held the folder.

mutations.name: no-takeover-guard
mutations.why: Two waiters that both judged the planted lock dead both remove and remake it: the second removes the first's new lock.

mutations.name: no-rejudge-inside-guard
mutations.why: takeOver acting on the main loop's judgement: a waiter that saw the dead lock gets the guard after another has already taken over, and removes that holder's lock.

mutations.name: takeover-without-judging
mutations.why: A takeover that removes any lock it finds removes one a waiter has just made and not yet written its owner into: that waiter's writeFileSync fails with ENOENT.

mutations.name: no-fairness
mutations.why: Without fairness a waiter may stop forever; Termination must catch that.
